facts_raw.Funding / Support: Free accelerator, investor introductions, grant/loan support, ÉTS labs/infrastructure; no direct accelerator investment
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity; 100% free; no fee, deposit or IP rights requested
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 项目具有现实商业化潜力；存在 significant technological advance 和/或 patentable innovation；符合 Centech 的重点 sector/technology vectors。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 技术原型；IP/专利策略；研究/工程背景；能在12周内验证商业化路径。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 12周，约25小时/周。官网项目页写 In person, Montreal；FAQ称 workshops/conferences hybrid，但强烈建议实体参加，海外申请人必须在 Montreal 参与12周。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 需在 Montreal 12周。官方称参加项目通常不需要 Canadian work permit，并可在需要时提供 visa acceptance letter。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Two cohorts per year (Fall and Winter); submit interest for next cohort
facts_raw.Application Materials: 项目申请；最多9页 presentation；60秒项目视频；通过筛选后向 selection committee 做10分钟 pitch/Q&A。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官网 Submit your interest / info sessions。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Deeptech / medtech / edtech，技术有显著创新或可专利；愿意在 Montreal 高强度参与12周的 founder。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 纯 SaaS/消费应用且无显著技术创新；无法投入约25小时/周；不能赴 Montreal；只会英语且无法适应以法语为主的 workshop。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：对真正 deeptech/medtech founder 很好，但 Montreal 在场与法语环境是重要门槛，不能把它当 remote global accelerator 推荐。

facts.Funding / Support: Free accelerator, investor introductions, grant/loan support, ÉTS labs/infrastructure; no direct accelerator investment
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity; 100% free; no fee, deposit or IP rights requested
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Commercial potential and significant technological or patentable innovation aligned with Centech's technology focus.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Technical prototype, IP or patent strategy, research or engineering background and a commercialization path testable within 12 weeks.
facts.On-site / Attendance: 12 weeks at approximately 25 hours per week. The program page specifies Montreal in person; the FAQ describes hybrid workshops, but strongly recommends attendance. International applicants must participate in Montreal for 12 weeks.
facts.Visa / Relocation: Twelve weeks in Montreal. The organizer states that a Canadian work permit is generally unnecessary and a visa acceptance letter can be provided if needed.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Two cohorts per year (Fall and Winter); submit interest for next cohort
facts.Application Materials: Application, presentation of no more than nine pages and a 60-second project video, followed by a ten-minute selection-committee pitch and Q&A.
facts.Public Contact Route: Official interest form or information sessions.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Deeptech, medtech and edtech founders with significant or patentable innovation who can participate intensively in Montreal for 12 weeks.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Undifferentiated SaaS or consumer apps, founders unable to commit approximately 25 hours weekly or attend Montreal, or unable to participate in predominantly French workshops.
facts.Notes: Strong fit for deeptech and medtech. Montreal attendance and a predominantly French workshop environment are material considerations; this is not a remote global program.
